dir.description: Directory where bonnie++ performs its IO and file tests.

size.description: Total size (in MiB) of test file(s). Must be >0 to enable IO tests.

size_suffix.description: Suffix for size: 'g' for GiB (e.g., '1g' = 1024 MiB).

chunk_size.description: Chunk size in bytes for IO tests. Must be power of 2 between 256–1048576.

chunk_suffix.description: Suffix for chunk_size: 'k' for KiB (e.g., '4k' = 4096 bytes).

seeks.description: Number of random seek operations to perform.

file_count.description: Number of small files to create/test, in multiples of 1024. 0 skips this test.

file_count_suffix.description: Suffix for file_count: 'k' for Ki (e.g., '1k' = 1024 files).

max_size.description: Maximum file size (bytes) for small-file test. Use -1 for hard links, -2 for soft links.

min_size.description: Minimum file size (bytes) for small-file test. Only used if max_size > 0.

num_directories.description: Number of subdirectories to spread small files across.

file_chunk.description: Chunk size (bytes) for small-file read/write operations.

machine_name.description: Display name for this host in the test report.

ram_size.description: System RAM size (MiB). Used for sanity checks. 0 disables checks (auto-detected if omitted).

num_tests.description: Number of test runs. Set to 0 for continuous runs until manually killed.

test_user.description: User ID (by name or numeric) to run tests as. Never run as root unless necessary.

test_group.description: Group ID (by name or numeric) to run tests as.

quiet_mode.description: If true, output only CSV on stdout (stderr remains for text). Enables easy logging to CSV.

char_test_size.description: If non-empty, enables per-char IO tests and sets their size (e.g., '20M'). Empty skips tests.

no_buffering.description: If true, use fsync() after every write (disable write buffering).

direct_io.description: If true, use O_DIRECT for bulk IO tests (bypass filesystem cache).

random_seed.description: Random number seed for reproducible runs. Same seed yields identical file contents.

random_file.description: Path to pre-generated random data file (network byte order). Overrides -z seed.
